name: Default
shortDescription: HTTP API and web UI that converts PDF, DOCX, PPTX, HTML and image files into Markdown, JSON and other structured formats with Docling, running on CPU.

alerts.message: Conversion and task requests need the X-Api-Key header set to the generated DOCLING_SERVE_API_KEY, shown in the environment variables. The web UI at /ui asks for the same key before running conversions.
